thread:
Maya Singh: hitting intermittent CERT_VERIFY failures when running our async load tests against Dedicated in a customer VPC + proxy. only under high concurrency. passing verify='/etc/ssl/cust_chain.pem' to AsyncClient but still see failures. anyone seen this? :thinking:

Ben Patel: do you have a tiny repro? sync vs async matters.

Maya Singh: async. minimal snippet:```py
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient(api_key='x', base_url='https://private.example', proxies={'https':'http://proxy:3128'}, verify='/etc/ssl/cust_chain.pem')
# spawn 200 coros each creating its own AsyncClient -> some TLS errors
```

Sanjay Rao: common causes: 1) creating many clients -> SSLContext/pool races, 2) Path vs str coercion (our wrapper might drop or mishandle Path), 3) proxy doing TLS interception with varying intermediates. which python/httpx versions?

Maya Singh: python 3.11, httpx 0.23.3. failures target a couple of hosts in same region. switching to a shared AsyncClient drastically reduced failures. passing an ssl.SSLContext also made the errors go away in quick smoke tests.

Ben Patel: suggests we should: - accept ca_bundle: str | Path | ssl.SSLContext in the public API (typed), - coerce Path -> str, - if given a path build one SSLContext at init and reuse it for all pools and proxy code paths. Also normalize base_url (strip trailing slash) to avoid URL join issues.

Maya Singh: +1. my IDE didn't show verify param on our wrapper so I missed it. typed TLSConfig or ca_bundle would help discoverability.

Ben Patel: created ticket DEVEX-2010 to fix pooling+verify race and DEVEX-2011 to add typed ca_bundle/tls config + env var precedence (explicit > REDWOOD_CA_BUNDLE > system). I'll add a short quickstart snippet recommending: share one AsyncClient, or pass ssl.SSLContext loaded with full chain.

Sanjay Rao: also add an integration test that simulates a proxy rotating intermediate certs so we catch flakey verification in CI.

Maya Singh: workaround for anyone blocked: share a single AsyncClient across coroutines, or pass a preloaded ssl.SSLContext (ssl.create_default_context(); load_verify_locations('/etc/ssl/full_chain.pem')). include intermediates in the PEM when proxies intercept.

devex-bot: DEVEX-2010 and DEVEX-2011 created and linked.
